result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered, but there is one notable defect: the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab. The 'Profile' tab is shown as active (green) even though the visible screen is clearly the Home/discovery feed, which can confuse users about their current location in the app.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows 'Profile' as the active/highlighted tab (green icon and label) while the content displayed is the Home screen (delivery address, search bar, promos, restaurant lists). The 'Home' tab appears inactive/gray.
issues.suggestion: Fix the active-tab state logic so the 'Home' tab is highlighted when the home feed is displayed, and ensure the highlighted nav item always matches the currently rendered screen.
